title: dryopteris filix-mas var. khasiana
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas var. khasiana, commonly known as Himalayan Male Fern, is a variant of the Male Fern plant native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Male Fern include its ability to reduce inflammation, as well as its antiviral and antibacterial properties, making it useful in treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
